title: Operators have no route to stop or disable a running computer
description: Found while writing docs/OWNER_CREDENTIAL_REVOCATION.md (PR 551): the only operator levers are suspend and reinstate for an organization. A suspended organization cannot start a new computer, but an already-running owner is unaffected; the runbook has to tell the operator to suspend first and then run ecs stop-task by hand, after which the control plane settles the computer itself after the 30 second heartbeat timeout. Add an operator route (and members-CLI command) that marks a computer stopped and asks the live owner to stop through the supervisor poll (stop request with reason operator, always approved), with an audit record. Acceptance: Gherkin scenarios (operator stops a live owner: the poll answers stop, the supervisor publishes and exits; non-operator refused; audit written), runbook updated to use it.
right_now_summary: Operators still lack a way to stop a running computer; a stop route and CLI command are needed.
